A '''Discharge Modulator''' was a component used on [[orbital nightcloak]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]]. It was located underneath the [[electromagnetic absorption panel]]s when they were not deployed. Once the panels had opened, the Modulator was open to [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="EGWT" />
